items.text: Chamber of Public Secrets (CPS) founded as an art and curatorial collective by Khaled Ramadan
|Khaled Ramadan: Beirut-born artist, filmmaker and curator based in Copenhagen; author of Peripheral Insider (Copenhagen University Press, 2007)
|Alfredo Cramerotti: Italian curator and writer; Director, Media Majlis Museum, Northwestern Qatar; President of IKT; author of Aesthetic Journalism (2009)
